newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Speed limit order causes chaos on Tanzanian roads.
newsitem.headline: Speed limit order causes chaos on Tanzanian roads.

text.p: Bus services throughout Tanzania were in chaos as traffic police enforced a new road safety order, local newspapers reported on Sunday.

Under an order that took effect on Saturday buses must be fitted with devices to limit speed to 80 km (47 miles) per hour. But many bus operators ignored the order designed to cut road accidents, police officials said.

The semi-official Sunday News said bus services in many areas were crippled as police ordered buses off the road. Dar es Salaam regional police commander Alfred Gewe was quoted as saying that only 202 out of 385 buses inspected complied with the new rule.
The government is trying to reduce road accidents which claimed over 1,000 lives last year.
